caption: The drawing features two separate square compositions, each centered vertically on a plain beige background. Each square consists of a central red rectangular block. In the top square, this red block is vertically flanked by narrower blue rectangles above and below, followed by light beige horizontal strips and, outward from those, thin green segments. The edges of the top square are bordered by a light brown band decorated with a spiral motif on the top and bottom, and a diamond pattern on the left and right. The interior background space is filled with tight rows of small dashed black marks. The lower square also centers a red horizontal rectangle, flanked on each vertical side by blue rectangles adjacent to lighter beige strips. The left and right sides of the lower square are bordered by vertical red bands filled with small orange and white motifs, while the top and bottom are outlined with simple vertical black lines. The remaining interior space is filled with short, looping black lines. At the bottom right corner of the drawing, the name "Eva Watson" is written in small print.
title: Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
